name: Pre-Construction, Planning & Engineering
scope_inclusions: Architectural design, CAD drafting, as-built laser measurement; structural engineering calcs & wet stamps; civil site/grading plans; geotechnical soil bore testing; boundary/topographical surveys; pre-design destructive discovery; CCTV sewer lateral scoping; permit packet submittals, plan check coordination, municipal review fee administration.
scope_exclusions: Physical job-site fencing, temporary power, site demo.

name: Sight Prep & Environmental Controls
scope_inclusions: Silt fence, wattle/SWPPP sediment controls, tree protection fencing; construction entrance stabilized gravel tracking pad; site clearing, grubbing, topsoil stripping & stockpiling; temporary security/perimeter fencing, job signage, dumpster & material staging layout.
scope_exclusions: Mass excavation, tree clearing beyond designated site footprint.

name: Temporary Utilities & Facilities
scope_inclusions: Temporary power pole (TPole), overhead/underground service drops, temporary distribution/GFCI spider boxes; temporary job-site water hookup/backflow preventer; portable sanitation (porta-potty) servicing contracts; temporary job-site task lighting; temporary job-site heating/conditioning equipment & fuel allowances (propane/electric) prior to permanent HVAC startup.
scope_exclusions: Permanent utility tap fees, permanent electrical meter base.

name: Demo/ Hazardous Abatement
scope_inclusions: Whole-structure razing, structural load wall removal, interior partition tear-out; concrete/asphalt pavement breakout & haul-off; chimney/masonry removal; selective MEP strip-out; MEP utility safe-offs, LOTO isolation, and plumbing/gas capping; temporary dust containment, negative air scrubbers, and bulk waste egress corridors; EPA RRP lead-safe work practices, asbestos survey/chain-of-custody protocols, and crystalline silica exposure controls; structural shoring and lateral bracing during cutouts; site extractions (vegetation, fencing, deck footings); dumpster logistics and certified disposal manifest archiving.
scope_exclusions: Mass dirt excavation, utility disconnections at city main.

name: Excavation & Structural Earthwork
scope_inclusions: Foundation/basement mass excavation, footing trenching; elevator pit depression excavation (if applicable); over-excavation & engineered structural fill import; vibratory plate/roller compaction & proctor density testing; footing step-downs, rough grading, spoil removal, basement dig-out; foundation perimeter backfill with native/engineered granular material mechanically compacted in 8″ lifts.
scope_exclusions: Under-slab utility trenching, capillary rock bed.

name: Underground Plumbing (Civil & Slab Rough)
scope_inclusions: Building main drain, sewer lateral connection to street/septic; interior fixture DWV slab stub-ups; water service entrance pipe, interior main distribution sleeves; floor drains, sub-slab passive radon vent collection T-pipes and gravel beds; elevator pit sump sleeve / oil-water separator rough-in; 10-ft head water / 5 PSI air pressure testing.
scope_exclusions: Trenching outside 5 ft of foundation, capillary gravel.

name: Underground Electrical & Telecom Raceways
scope_inclusions: Main service conduit to transformer/pedestal; meter base stub-ups; sub-panel conduits, electric vehicle/generator conduits; telecom/fiber optic Schedule 40/80 PVC sweeps (min 2″ with pull tape/MuleTape); ufer ground wire & ground rods; underground detectable warning tape.
scope_exclusions: Pulling wire/conductors, trenching across finished yard.

name: Pre-Pour & Concrete Placement Inspections
scope_inclusions: Subgrade soil compaction audit, capillary gravel depth verification; continuous 15-mil vapor barrier inspection (taped seams, pipe boots, perimeter mastic); rebar size, grade, spacing, clear cover (dobies), dowels, hold-downs, anchor bolts, elevator pit rebar/waterstops; municipal pre-pour hold point; batch plant ticket auditing, slump testing, cylinder break casting (ASTM C31), placement vibration monitoring.
scope_exclusions: Formwork construction, concrete finishing labor.

name: Concrete Foundations & Slabs
scope_inclusions: Footing forming and placement, stem walls (formed or ICF), monolithic slabs-on-grade; elevator pit drop/slab formation; interior slab floating and mechanical troweling; anchor bolt and hold-down wet-setting; form stripping, concrete curing compound / wet cure blankets; control joint saw-cutting; exterior foundation wall spray elastomeric dampproofing/waterproofing, perimeter rigid XPS foam / dimple drainage board protection, perforated footing drain tile (socked/washed stone bedding) tied to daylight/sump basin.
scope_exclusions: Backfill compaction, self-leveling floor underlayment.

name: Masonry: Load-Bearing Walls & Foundations
scope_inclusions: Structural CMU block walls, basement foundation walls; core rebar placement, cleanout inspection gates; pea-gravel grout core consolidation (high-lift/low-lift pumping); bond beam block, lintel block, sill plates anchor bolt embedment.
scope_exclusions: Adhered stone veneer, brick chimneys above roof.

name: Framing Phase 1: Structural Shell & Primary Air Barrier Lid
scope_inclusions: Mudsills, anchor washers, subfloor framing, exterior load-bearing walls, structural steel I-beams and lally columns; engineered roof trusses/rafters; exterior wall OSB sheathing; continuous ceiling structural air barrier lid (taped 7/16″ or 1/2″ OSB across truss bottom chords); structural shear wall nailing and hold-down hardware; exterior rough buck integration and structural rough openings for windows, exterior doors, package delivery portals, and structural overhead garage door jamb framing / spring pad mounting.
scope_exclusions: Interior non-bearing partitions, dropped ceiling joists.

name: Building Envelope: Air Barrier & WRB
scope_inclusions: Housewrap or self-adhered vapor-permeable air barrier membrane; seams taped with high-performance acrylic flashing tape; rough opening flexible sill pan flashing for windows, doors, and parcel portals; penetrations, pipe boots, and electrical sleeves gasketed/sealed; rainscreen furring/drainage mat; brick lintel and weep screed terminations.
scope_exclusions: Siding materials, roofing underlayment, window unit setting.

name: Roofing Systems & Specialty Sheet Metal
scope_inclusions: Ice & water shield membrane (eaves, valleys, rakes, low-pitch decks); synthetic roof underlayment; architectural asphalt shingles, standing seam metal panels, or low-slope membrane; valley metal, drip edge, gutter aprons, step/counter flashing at chimneys and sidewalls; lead/EPDM plumbing vent pipe boots, attic exhaust vents, fireplace chimney termination storm collars and caps; rooftop solar PV conduit flashing boots and structural solar mounting stanchions (if specked).
scope_exclusions: Rain gutters/downspouts, attic insulation baffles.

name: Framing Phase 2: Partitions & Dropped Service Ceilings
scope_inclusions: Non-bearing interior partition walls; dropped ceiling framing (2x4 joists/grids suspended below continuous OSB lid); pocket door frames, bypass frames; fireplace chase framing, non-combustible steel-stud clearances, hearth sub-framing; elevator hoistway shaft framing or stacked future-elevator closet alignment (knockout floor framing, continuous double 2\times12 or LVL rail-mounting backing, overhead carriage clearance framing); parcel drop interior receiving cabinet / security chase framing; plumbing chases, duct soffits; solid lumber backing for vanities, grab bars, towel rods, cabinetry, floating shelves, stair handrails, heavy wall-mounted TVs, and fireplace mantels.
scope_exclusions: Structural shell framing, exterior rough bucks.

name: Exterior Doors, Windows & Overhead Doors
scope_inclusions: Window and exterior door unit setting, shimming, plumb/level verification; fasteners into structural bucks; self-adhered jamb and head flashing tape over flanges; head drip cap flashings; temporary window film protection; exterior patio slider and French door track install; secure exterior delivery portals and parcel chutes (sill pan flashing, unit anchoring, perimeter air sealing); sectional insulated overhead garage doors, heavy-duty commercial track mounting, high-cycle torsion spring assembly, perimeter weatherstripping vinyl stop seals, and smart low-voltage jackshaft or ceiling-hung garage door openers.
scope_exclusions: Finish interior door units, casing trim, glass mirrors.

name: Exterior Masonry Veneers
scope_inclusions: Adhered stone veneer, thin brick, anchored full brick, or cultured stone; metal lath and mortar scratch coats; weep screeds, cavity drainage plane, brick ties to framing; mortar joint striking, masonry window sills, stone water table transition caps.
scope_exclusions: Interior fireplace stone, concrete flatwork.

name: Exterior Siding, Soffit, Fascia & Gutters
scope_inclusions: Lap siding, board-and-batten, or panel siding (fiber cement, engineered wood, cedar); Z-flashing over masonry caps and window headers; vented aluminum or wood soffit panels; fascia sub-fascia and metal wrap; exterior frieze boards, trim casing; seamless aluminum/copper rain gutters, gutter leaf guards, and vertical downspouts connected with clean transitions into pre-installed subterranean cleanout boots.
scope_exclusions: Underground storm drain lines, roof underlayment/drip edge.

name: Rough HVAC & Mechanicals
scope_inclusions: Supply trunks and return plenums routed through dropped service cavity; rigid/flexible branch runs; direct-vent gas/wood fireplace chassis placement, intake/exhaust co-axial pipe routing, wall thimble, and exterior roof/wall cap; commercial-grade kitchen range hood exhaust duct (8″ or 10″ rigid galvanized with backdraft damper) and interlocked motorized makeup air (MUA) damper system; HRV/ERV ventilation ducts; bathroom exhaust fan units and exterior discharge ducting; refrigerant line sets, condensate drains; furnace/air handler cabinet setting.
scope_exclusions: Line-voltage power wiring, appliance hood mounting.

name: Rough Plumbing & Life Safety Systems
scope_inclusions: Interior PEX/copper water supply distribution manifolds and branch lines; DWV drain stacks, branch vents, and roof flashing boot connections; vertical continuous 3″ or 4″ PVC radon vent stack routed through roof flashing boot; NFPA 13D residential fire sprinkler CPVC/PEX distribution piping, seismic bracing, and concealed ceiling drop heads (if required); gas supply piping (black iron/CSST) with pressure test gauge to water heater, furnace, range, dryer, and gas fireplace drop; shower mixing valves, laundry supply/drain boxes, frost-free hose bibbs; drop-in fiberglass or cast-iron tubs set.
scope_exclusions: Underground slab plumbing, setting toilets/faucets.

name: Rough Electrical & Renewable Energy Prep
scope_inclusions: Service entrance panels, sub-panels; branch circuit wiring (Romex/MC cable); outlet boxes, switch boxes, junction boxes; recessed ceiling light cans (IC-rated) attached to dropped ceiling framing; dedicated 240V appliance circuits (range, dryer, water heater); dedicated 50A/60A Level 2 EV charging home runs; rooftop solar PV conduit chase down to main electrical service room; whole-home automatic generator transfer switch (ATS) rough-in & battery backup (BESS) conduit prep; dedicated 240V elevator machine disconnect, pit/shaft lighting circuit, and stair lift drops; attic radon fan dedicated junction box; garage door opener receptacles and safety beam sensor low-voltage wire; package portal power / solenoid lock rough-in; fireplace 120V blower outlet box and wall switch/thermostat control wiring; gas piping and water service grounding/bonding; arc-fault/ground-fault breaker prep.
scope_exclusions: Low-voltage data/audio, finish switches/fixtures.

name: Low Voltage & Data Rough-In
scope_inclusions: Structured media enclosure cabinet; Cat6/Cat6A data drops, RG6 coaxial runs; whole-home multi-room audio speaker wiring; security sensor wiring, smart doorbell wiring; motorized shade pre-wiring; home automation control bus wiring; package portal smart camera/intercom and electronic access controller cabling; dedicated analog/cellular bridge emergency phone line to elevator hoistway; fireplace home automation integration / smart wall relay wiring.
scope_exclusions: Line-voltage wiring, hanging TVs/speakers.

name: Thermal & Moisture Protection
scope_inclusions: Exterior wall cavity insulation (mineral wool, fiberglass batts, or dense-pack cellulose); rim joist, penetrations, and can-light two-component closed-cell spray foam air sealing; blown-in attic insulation (fiberglass/cellulose) over upper primary OSB lid to design R-value; firestopping and rockwool insulation at fireplace chase, elevator shaft, radon stack, and chimney penetrations; parcel portal perimeter draft air sealing and insulated chase wrapping; attic ventilation baffles and access hatch weatherstripping/insulation covers.
scope_exclusions: Primary ceiling air barrier OSB lid, housewrap WRB.

name: Pre-Drywall Inspections & Quality Sign-Off
scope_inclusions: Municipal combined rough-in inspections (Framing, Plumbing, Mechanical, Electrical, Fire Sprinkler); in-house nail plate verification (stud protection for pipes/wires); post-MEP framing backing and blocking verification walk (vanities, handrails, fireplace TV mounts, elevator rail backing, accessories); preliminary building envelope air leakage test (pre-drywall blower door or aerosol air-sealing audit); rough MEP photographic/laser 3D documentation prior to cover.
scope_exclusions: Drywall stocking or hanging labor.

name: Drywall Hanging, Taping & Mudding
scope_inclusions: 1/2″ and 5/8″ Type X gypsum board installation on all walls and dropped ceilings; non-combustible cement board / glass-mat panels at fireplace face opening and clearance zones; 1-hour or 2-hour fire-rated Type X shaft-liner drywall installation inside elevator hoistways with acoustic/fire caulk seals; mud-set rigid vinyl or paper-faced corner beads; fiberglass mesh or paper tape embedding (first coat); second fill coat; skim/finish coats (Level 4 or Level 5 specification); drywall fire-caulking at penetrations.
scope_exclusions: Drywall sanding, PVA primer paint.

name: Drywall Dry-Out & Dehumidification
scope_inclusions: Placement of commercial industrial air movers and LGR dehumidifiers; ambient relative humidity and substrate moisture monitoring; exhaust ventilation to clear moisture without shocking fresh joint compound.
scope_exclusions: Temporary heating equipment/fuel rental.

name: Drywall Sanding & Rough Clean
scope_inclusions: Mechanical dustless vacuum sanding (rotary orbital drywall sanders) and pole hand-sanding; feathering all joints and fastener heads; raking-light joint flatness inspection; complete broom sweep, scrap removal, and commercial HEPA vacuuming of subfloors and framing plates.
scope_exclusions: PVA primer spraying, cosmetic point-up.

name: Full PVA Primer (Walls & Ceilings)
scope_inclusions: Full spray and back-roll of dedicated PVA drywall sealer/primer across all wall and ceiling drywall surfaces; window and MEP box masking; encapsulation of all remaining microscopic gypsum dust.
scope_exclusions: Finish paint topcoats, trim painting.

name: Drywall Point-Up & Spot-Prime
scope_inclusions: Handheld 500+ lumen raking-light inspection pass; filling surface pinholes, tape blisters, scratches, and gouges with fast-drying compound; hand sponge/block sanding; mini-roller spot-priming of repaired patches to eliminate sheen flashing.
scope_exclusions: Finish wall painting, ceiling painting.

name: Final Ceiling Topcoat Painting
scope_inclusions: Final finish ceiling paint coats (two coats dead flat) sprayed/rolled continuously wall-to-wall; complete ceiling sign-off before floor finishes or cabinets mobilize.
scope_exclusions: Wall finish coats, trim enamel.

name: HVAC Startup & Climate Conditioning
scope_inclusions: Startup of permanent central heating/cooling system; sacrificial MERV 8 filters installed on all return grilles; setting baseline conditioning (68°F–72°F, 40%–50% RH) for interior finish acclimation; floor returns sealed.
scope_exclusions: Final test-and-balance TAB, permanent high-efficiency media filters.

name: Interior Masonry Veneers
scope_inclusions: Adhered stone fireplaces, thin brick feature walls, structural masonry interior accents; fireplace hearth stone pads, non-combustible surrounds, mortar joint tooling, brick acid/sponge washdown, masonry dust sealing.
scope_exclusions: Exterior masonry, tile surrounds.

name: Tile Substrates, Wet Surrounds & Waterproofing
scope_inclusions: Cement backer board / waterproof foam board installation; bonded sheet waterproofing or liquid-applied elastomeric membranes (e.g., Schluter Kerdi, Hydro Ban); cultured marble panels, solid surface shower walls, composite shower pans; uncoupling membranes (Ditra) on concrete/wood subfloors; niche and curb assemblies; mandatory 24-hour standing water plumbing shower pan flood test with mechanical test plug and inspection sign-off.
scope_exclusions: Setting floor/wall tiles, rough plumbing mixing valves.

name: Finish Carpentry Phase 1: Interior Doors
scope_inclusions: Pre-hung door units (solid-core or hollow-core) set, shimmed, fastened, plumbed; pocket door slabs hung and adjusted; bypass track hardware; temporary passage handles installed for door latching.
scope_exclusions: Door casings and baseboards, finish hardware levers.

name: Floor Coverings Phase 1: Hard Surfaces & Prep
scope_inclusions: Substrate moisture testing (in-situ concrete RH probes per ASTM F2170 & wood pin meter readings); mechanical diamond grinding of slab high spots/ridges; subfloor plywood seam sanding; specialty substrate primers and cementitious self-leveling underlayment (SLU) to achieve \pm 1/8\text{''} in 10-ft flatness tolerances; floor tile setting, polymer-modified thinset mortar, grouting, and grout sealing; site-finished or pre-finished hardwood flooring installation; heavy-duty temporary floor protection board (Ram Board) taped seam-to-seam.
scope_exclusions: Carpet/soft flooring, baseboards.

name: Finish Carpentry: Paint-Grade Trim & Casing
scope_inclusions: Baseboards, door casings, window stools, aprons, crown moulding; wall wainscoting, shiplap, and board-and-batten; closet shelving cleats and closet rods; nail hole filling, sanding, and painter's caulk at all wood-to-drywall joints.
scope_exclusions: Pre-finished millwork/cabinets, stain-grade handrails, finish spray painting.

name: Painting: Interior Walls & Trim
scope_inclusions: Spraying/brushing finish enamel on interior door slabs, door casings, baseboards, and trim; rolling two coats of washable wall finish paint (eggshell/matte/satin); cutting clean lines along ceilings and trim edges.
scope_exclusions: Ceiling topcoat, PVA primer, final post-move-in punch.

name: Epoxy Floor Coatings
scope_inclusions: Mechanical diamond-grinding/shot-blasting of concrete garage/utility floors; crack routing and structural polyurea joint filling; moisture-vapor barrier epoxy primer, decorative color flake broadcast to rejection, UV-stable polyaspartic/polyurethane clear topcoats.
scope_exclusions: Exterior concrete driveways, interior tile.

name: Finish Carpentry: Pre-Finished Architectural Millwork
scope_inclusions: Prefabricated and custom cabinetry carcasses set, shimmed, and bolted; filler panels, crown headers, toe kicks; floating wood shelves, stain-grade fireplace mantels, custom fireplace flanking built-in media cabinets/shelving, architectural decorative wood ceiling beams; pre-finished stain-grade stair handrails, wall-mounted handrail brackets, newel posts, guardrail shoes, architectural metal/wood baluster infill, and cable railing fittings.
scope_exclusions: Paint-grade trim, countertops, cabinet knobs/pulls.

name: Countertops, Architectural Stone & Solid Surfaces
scope_inclusions: Digital laser templating; quartz, granite, marble, or quartzite slabs; fabrication of sink cutouts and faucet holes; seam bonding with tinted epoxy; waterfall miter legs, island vertical stone face cladding, full-height stone slab backsplashes, solid slab fireplace hearth caps and decorative surround fascias, solid surface window sills.
scope_exclusions: Undermount sink faucet plumbing hookups, cabinet carcass leveling.

name: Finish Electrical & Renewable Energy Terminations
scope_inclusions: Designer receptacles, rocker switches, dimmers, smart switches, cover plates; decorative chandeliers, vanity lights, pendant fixtures, under-cabinet LED tape lights; ceiling fans; circuit breaker panel final labeling; testing GFCIs and AFCIs; Level 2 EV charging station mounting and termination; standby generator ATS controls / solar inverter interlock terminations; fireplace blower fan wiring, wall control switch, and remote receiver hookup; final terminations to elevator machine disconnect, hoistway pit lights/switches, and stair lift charging station; building-attached exterior lighting (porch sconces, soffit downlights, exterior floodlights, WR-rated outdoor GFCIs with in-use covers).
scope_exclusions: Landscape yard lighting, low-voltage data jacks.

name: Finish Plumbing
scope_inclusions: Undermount sink mounting, kitchen and bathroom faucet installations; garbage disposal; dishwasher water and drain connections; toilet setting (wax rings, closet bolts, braided supply lines, tank adjustment); shower heads, handheld wands, trim kits; gas fireplace final flex line hookup, shutoff valve testing, gas pressure verification, burner tray media setup (logs/glass); water heater commissioning, expansion tank pressure check, PRV calibration.
scope_exclusions: Shower valves in wall, shower pan waterproofing.

name: Finish HVAC & Final Commissioning
scope_inclusions: Removal of temporary construction filters, coil clean check, installation of final high-efficiency media air filters; decorative supply registers and return air grilles; smart thermostat installation, Wi-Fi pairing; fireplace ignition testing, flame sensor audit, drafting test, and safety shutoff verification; radon active mitigation fan startup & U-tube manometer suction verification (if activated); test-and-balance (TAB) airflow velocity measurement, static pressure verification, equipment warranty registration.
scope_exclusions: Rough duct installation, electrical line-voltage hookups.

name: Finish Low Voltage & Data
scope_inclusions: Termination of Cat6 jacks into wall faceplates; structured media panel patch cord punch-down; Wi-Fi access points (WAPs) mounted; TV wall mounts, audio speakers and subwoofers hooked up; security keypad, camera mounting, smart hub programming; activation and audio dial-tone test of emergency elevator cab phone/dialer; parcel delivery portal smart lock/intercom programming and mobile app pairing; garage door opener Wi-Fi integration and wireless keypad programming.
scope_exclusions: Rough low-voltage wire pulls, 120V power receptacles.

name: Appliances
scope_inclusions: Delivery, uncrating, and positioning of kitchen appliances (refrigerator, slide-in/wall ovens, cooktop, microwave drawer, beverage cooler); leveling and anti-tip bracket installation; range hood duct connection; waterline connections, drain loops, electrical hookups; factory test runs.
scope_exclusions: Plumbing water/drain connections, electrical feeds, range hood 10″ duct runs.

name: Hardware & Wall Specialties
scope_inclusions: Architectural door levers, deadbolts, keyless smart locks; door stops; bathroom hardware (towel bars, paper holders, robe hooks anchored into solid backing); cabinet handles, drawer pulls; custom closet organizing systems; metal transition strips; parcel drop internal retrieval doors, electronic access keypads, anti-theft locking baffles, and delivery hatch commissioning; residential elevator rail alignment, cab sling/car assembly, hydraulic/traction drive mechanics, hoistway door interlocks, and cab interior panel finishing (vendor oversight); surface-mounted motorized stair lift track fastening to stair treads, carriage mounting, and safety sensor calibration.
scope_exclusions: Pre-hung door hanging, cabinet carcass mounting.

name: Shower Glass & Mirrors
scope_inclusions: Heavy custom frameless glass shower enclosures (3/8″ or 1/2″ tempered glass); glass clamps, hinges, silicone seals, door sweeps; vanity wall mirrors glued/bracketed; full-length framed dressing mirrors.
scope_exclusions: Tile substrate waterproofing, shower plumbing valves.

name: Floor Coverings Phase 2: Soft Surfaces
scope_inclusions: Removal of floor protection over tile/hardwood; carpet tack strip fastening, premium carpet pad laying, wall-to-wall carpet stretching and seaming; carpet transitions to tile/wood; final vacuuming and re-covering with lightweight film runners.
scope_exclusions: Hard surface tile/hardwood, baseboard install.

name: Final Deep Clean
scope_inclusions: Removal of all protective plastics and films; interior/exterior window washing (scraping stickers/paint specks); vacuuming tracks; wiping down inside/outside of all cabinets and drawers; scrubbing plumbing fixtures, tile, countertops, baseboards, and hard floors; whole-house turnover ready.
scope_exclusions: Routine trade broom sweeps, post-move-in touch-up.

name: Paint Touch-Ups Phase 1
scope_inclusions: Post-cleaning cosmetic pass: filling minor micro-scratches from trade move-outs; touch-up painting walls and trim with artist brushes and mini-rollers; caulking minor gaps exposed by final deep cleaning.
scope_exclusions: Heavy wall painting, furniture move-in damage.

name: Exterior Sleeving & Subsurface Storm Drainage
scope_inclusions: Schedule 40/80 electrical conduits sleeved under driveways and walkways (low-voltage lighting, gate power, bollards); irrigation main and lateral pipe sleeves under hardscape surfaces; subsurface roof runoff storm drainage piping (Baughman high-density heavy-duty solid corrugated / SDR-35 PVC); downspout transition boots, in-line vented cleanouts, debris filter boxes, pop-up discharge emitters with turf restrictor plates / French Drain Man bubbler sumps; grading trenches for gravity flow to daylight away from building foundation prior to flatwork placement.
scope_exclusions: Seamless metal gutters and vertical downspouts, landscape sprinkler pipes.

name: Exterior Flatwork & Hardscapes
scope_inclusions: Forming, reinforcing, and pouring concrete driveways, front porches, public sidewalks, patios; stamped, exposed aggregate, or broom finishes; pavers, retaining walls, decorative stone sitting walls, flagstone walkways.
scope_exclusions: Foundation slabs, sub-flatwork storm piping, landscaping.

name: Final Municipal Building Inspections
scope_inclusions: Municipal Final Building, Final Plumbing, Final Electrical, and Final Mechanical walkthroughs; safe egress paths and entry lighting verified; Fire Marshal life-safety sign-off (smoke/CO alarms, fire sprinkler sign-off); State / Jurisdictional Elevator Safety Authority operating permit inspection & witness test (if elevator is installed); Certificate of Occupancy (C.O.) or Certificate of Completion procurement.
scope_exclusions: Subcontractor rough inspections, engineering stamps.

name: Landscape & Yard Electrical
scope_inclusions: Deep trenching (18″–24″) for detached line-voltage yard features; dedicated circuits for fountains, pond pumps, detached fire pit igniters, and gate operators; low-voltage landscape lighting transformer installation, photocells, timers, and rough wire homerun pulls.
scope_exclusions: Building-attached lighting/sconces, shallow irrigation piping.

name: Irrigation & Finish Landscaping
scope_inclusions: Automatic sprinkler valves, lateral lines, spray/rotator heads, drip zones, smart irrigation controller; topsoil spreading, fine grading; sod installation / seeding; shrub/tree planting, bark mulch/decorative rock; perimeter boundary fence posts, gates, and latch hardware; aiming and staking low-voltage tree up-lights and pathway fixtures.
scope_exclusions: Deep electrical trenching, underground roof storm runoff lines.

name: Exterior Structures & Outdoor Living
scope_inclusions: Deck footings, ledger connection verification, treated/steel chassis framing; composite or hardwood decking boards; deck railings (cable, metal, glass); custom pergolas, metal louvered roofs, covered outdoor kitchens, fire pits.
scope_exclusions: Main house framing, concrete foundation piers.

name: Furnishings, Staging & Client Move-In
scope_inclusions: Furniture delivery, unboxing, room staging; art hanging, window drapery installation; client personal belongings move-in coordination; floor protection runners along high-traffic delivery routes.
scope_exclusions: Construction appliances, architectural millwork.

name: Paint Touch-Ups Phase 2 & Move-In Punch
scope_inclusions: Post-move-in cosmetic remediation; patching wall dings, corner bead gouges, and baseboard scrapes caused by furniture delivery; minor micro-caulking at trim-to-wall dry-out separations; final touch-up paint blending.
scope_exclusions: Phase 1 pre-inspection paint touch-ups, primary wall painting.

name: Generational Handover & Asset Commissioning
scope_inclusions: Comprehensive owner asset dossier turnover (digital PDF & archival physical binder); 3D/photographic in-wall rough MEP as-builts; mechanical shut-off map (main water, gas, irrigation, electrical panels); product warranty registrations (HVAC, roofing, appliances, windows, fireplaces, conveyance/lifts, delivery portal systems, garage openers); paint and finish schedule index (sheens, codes, formulas); equipment maintenance intervals and filter replacement schedule; formal client systems orientation and keys/fobs transfer.
scope_exclusions: Punch-list trade work, final clean.
